Tanuki Slots! Here's how the versus game works!{KP}When the game starts, the tanuki start spinning round and round and transforming!{KP}Press the Circle button to stop a tanuki's spin!{KP}Try to stop them so the same character lines up!{KP}Whoever scores more than their opponent wins!{KP}You only get 60 seconds, so don't dawdle and run out of time!{KP}1P is Momotaro-san, and 2P is Kintaro-san!
